question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Onion, Vegetable, Shirt
solution:
The venn diagram for given relationship is:

Onion is a type of Vegetable.

Shirt is a completely different entity and has no relation to Onion or Vegetable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6952a4914a07c4b94656db14497596d6003714f80b94d51781846607ae3db11f.png]
